tip.en: Unit 7: was / were, and everything from the course in one conversation.
tip.ru: Юнит 7: was / were и весь курс в одном разговоре.
tip.kk: 7-бөлім: was / were және бүкіл курс бір әңгімеде.

items.q: U2 · This is my sister. ___ name is Aliya.
U3 · ___ two bedrooms in my flat.
U3 · The meeting is ___ three o’clock.
U4 · She ___ up at five every day.
U5 · I like ___ in the evening.

lines: I [was|were|am] born in Karaganda in 1996. My parents [weren’t|wasn’t|aren’t] rich.
I [was|were|am] a quiet child, but I [was|were|am] very happy.
Last year I [was|were|am] in Almaty for my new job. It [was|were|is] great!
“[Were|Was|Are] you here last year?” — “No, I [wasn’t|weren’t|am not].”
Yesterday it [was|were|is] cold and rainy, so I [was|were|am] at home all day. 🌧

items.a: Would you like to join us

items.sit: U1 · 9 a.m. You meet a new client for the first time.
U2 · Someone asks: “So, what do you do?”
U3 · A new colleague asks where you live.
o: I live in a flat in Almaty.
I live on a flat in Almaty.
I am live in flat Almaty.

items.sit: U4 · You want to know how often your colleague travels.
U5 · You are in a café and you want one cup of coffee.
items.why: “I’d like…” is the polite way to order.

items.sit: U7 · Someone asks: “Were you here last year?” You were not.
o: No, I wasn’t. This is my first time.
No, I weren’t. This is my first time.
No, I am not here last year.

write.q: Write your first short story: 6 sentences about a good day in the past. Use was, were, wasn’t and weren’t.
write.model: Last summer I was in Turkey with my family. The weather was hot and sunny every day. Our hotel wasn’t expensive, but it was very nice. My parents weren’t with us — they were at home. There were five of us. It was a great holiday.

speak.q: Tell your story out loud, then answer: Where were you born? Where were you last year? Was it good?
speak.model: Last summer I was in Turkey. It was hot and sunny. The hotel wasn’t expensive, but it was nice. I was born in Karaganda. Last year I was in Almaty for my new job. Yes, it was great!
